title: Razkadr chunks artifact
description: Chunking stage output (naryad 008): thematic text chunks with timecodes, language and the transcript segments each chunk covers. See docs/artifacts.md.

id.description: Chunk identifier, unique within the artifact.

text.description: Chunk text assembled from transcript segments.

lang.description: Chunk language: the most frequent segment language in the chunk (naryad 008).

segment_ids.description: 0-based indexes of the transcript.json segments covered by this chunk, ascending; segments are never split across chunks (naryad 008).

schemaVersion.description: Artifact schema version, semver (patch may be omitted).

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag (und allowed for undetermined).
